score.rationale: Baytown Refinery scored 14 on the PdM model today. ExxonMobil's most recent 10-K, filed February 28, named Aspen Mtelligence and vibration analytics in the downstream capex section. Harris County issued a control room renovation permit at the Baytown address on April 16. Three workforce signals fired on the parent careers site over the last 45 days, including a Vibration Analyst opening that names OPC-UA and edge gateways. Suggested outreach window: next 21 days.

events.raw_text: ExxonMobil Baytown Refinery is hiring a Vibration Analyst to support our Reliability Center of Excellence. The role focuses on rotating equipment, motor current signature analysis, and acoustic monitoring across the FCC and reformer trains. Candidates with OPC-UA, edge gateway deployment, and remaining useful life modeling are preferred. This is a hands-on position partnering closely with the maintenance planning organization to reduce unplanned downtime on critical assets.

From the Q1 2026 ExxonMobil earnings call: 'We continue to scale our digital reliability program at our largest US sites, with Baytown leading the rollout of predictive maintenance and asset performance management tooling. We expect double-digit improvements in availability across the rotating equipment fleet over the next two years.'

Reliability Engineer, Baytown Refinery. Lead root cause investigations on rotating equipment, partner with the predictive maintenance group on sensor deployment, and own the asset health workflow inside the CMMS. Experience with Maximo, vibration analysis, and IIoT platforms strongly preferred.

RFP for condition monitoring services at a Department of Energy partner refinery facility in the Gulf Coast region. Scope includes wireless vibration sensors, ultrasonic monitoring of high-pressure piping, and an asset health dashboard integration with the existing CMMS. Five-year base with two option years.

CMMS Administrator, Baytown Refinery. Own the day-to-day operation of the work order management platform, drive PM compliance reporting, and support the upcoming evaluation of next-generation enterprise asset management tooling. Maximo or SAP PM administration experience required.

Permit issued for interior alteration of a control room and operator console area inside the existing industrial occupancy at 5000 Bayway Drive, Baytown TX. Scope includes low-voltage cabling, fiber pulls to the process unit, and reconfiguration of operator workstations to support new monitoring displays.

Texas SmartBuy posting from a state university research partner located adjacent to the Baytown industrial corridor. Requests proposals for vibration analysis software, wireless sensor mesh, and machine learning anomaly detection across pilot rotating equipment assets.

OSHA inspection at Baytown Refinery resulted in citations tied to process safety management and mechanical integrity program documentation. Inspection narrative references gaps in inspection records for rotating equipment and recommends a strengthened asset health and inspection tracking workflow.

Asset Performance Manager opening at the Baytown Refinery. Owns the strategy for predictive analytics on critical rotating and fixed equipment. Partners with the IT organization on the rollout of new asset performance management software and integration with existing work order systems.

FERC filing referencing capital expenditure on monitoring and control infrastructure at affiliated downstream assets in the Houston ship channel region, with budget line items for sensor instrumentation and asset health platforms.

From the ExxonMobil 10-K, downstream segment discussion: 'We are deploying predictive maintenance, condition monitoring, and asset performance management software at our largest refining and chemicals sites, including Baytown. Aspen Mtelligence, vibration analytics, and acoustic monitoring are core elements of the digital reliability program. Capital expenditure for these programs is expected to grow over the next three years.'

EPA ECHO record showing an air-quality consent decree tied to flaring incidents at the Baytown complex. Resolution plan calls for enhanced monitoring of emission control equipment and improved asset reliability reporting on rotating equipment in the affected process units.
